// The breaks of AskKit's public API that are meant, which `scripts/ci.sh api`
// lets through. The check compares AskCore and AskUI with the newest release
// tag and fails on any other break.
//
// A break you mean goes here in the pull request that makes it, with its entry
// in CHANGELOG.md: each line the check printed, as it stands, from
// `API breakage: ` on, one to a line. The list is emptied after each release,
// whose tag becomes the new baseline.
//
// A comment starts with //. The digester reads this file through the C
// preprocessor, and a line starting with # makes it read the whole list as
// empty, so `ci.sh api` refuses one.
API breakage: func AskContinuation.entersTail(tier:prose:) has been removed
API breakage: func AskContinuation.widened(_:with:) has been removed
API breakage: func AskFeedbackAttachments.removeAll() has been removed
API breakage: func askServableTiers(from:) has been removed
API breakage: func askUnavailability(from:) has been removed
API breakage: func askIsTierOutage(_:) has been removed
API breakage: func AskThreadArchive.archive(_:at:sparing:) has been removed
API breakage: func AppleModelSeam.make(privateCloudCompute:gate:logSubsystem:) has parameter 1 type change from AskCore.AskGenerationGate to Swift.String?
API breakage: func AskGenerationGate.run(isolation:gate:deadline:_:) has parameter 1 type change from AskCore.AskGenerationGate to Swift.Duration
API breakage: func AskGenerationGate.run(isolation:gate:deadline:_:) has parameter 2 type change from Swift.Duration to () async throws -> T
API breakage: func AskGenerationGate.run(isolation:gate:deadline:_:) has removed default argument from parameter 2
API breakage: constructor AppleModelSeam.init(status:privateCloudCompute:gate:logSubsystem:) has been removed
API breakage: func AppleModelSeam.make(privateCloudCompute:gate:logSubsystem:) has been renamed to func make(privateCloudCompute:logSubsystem:)
API breakage: constructor AskGenerationGate.init(logSubsystem:) has been removed
API breakage: func AskGenerationGate.run(isolation:gate:deadline:_:) has been renamed to func run(isolation:deadline:_:)

API breakage: func AskPrivateCloudState.of(_:) has return type change from AskUI.AskPrivateCloudState to AskUI.AskPrivateCloudState?
API breakage: constructor AskPrivateCloudCard.init(store:showsDiagnostics:onRunEval:) has parameter 1 type change from Swift.Bool to Swift.Bool?
API breakage: func AskCollector.record(payload:) is now throwing
API breakage: func AskCollector.record(payload:) has parameter 0 type change from Foundation.Data to some Swift.Encodable & Swift.Sendable
API breakage: func AskCollector.mergePayload(as:_:) is now without rethrows
API breakage: constructor AskProposal.init(id:kind:title:detail:actionLabel:systemImage:payload:) is now throwing

API breakage: constructor AskProposal.init(id:kind:title:detail:actionLabel:systemImage:payload:) has removed default argument from parameter 6

API breakage: enum AskPersistence has removed conformance to Encodable

API breakage: enum AskGroundingPolicy has removed conformance to Encodable

API breakage: var AskStarter.bank has been removed
API breakage: constructor AskStarter.init(id:text:bank:) has been removed
API breakage: var AppleModelSeam.reprobeInterval has declared type change from Foundation.TimeInterval to Swift.Duration

API breakage: var AppleModelSeam.transportCooldown has declared type change from Foundation.TimeInterval to Swift.Duration
